section: AVI-SPL Symphony and HP|Poly: AI in meetings, battery-status ticketing and AI-generated Tier 1 troubleshooting
body:
A guest blog by Laurie Berg, AVI-SPL Vice President, Symphony Product Operations, explains how AI has changed meetings and how AVI-SPL Symphony works with HP|Poly devices. For run and support, the key content is how Symphony uses AI signals to raise tickets and speed up Tier 1 troubleshooting.

**Background the author gives**
- Decades ago video conferencing was less widespread and very manual: views were switched with a remote control and microphones were moved to pick up the active speaker.
- A few years ago, when people became used to video collaboration from home, users still had to cope with background noise, network struggles and the combined load of listening, reading and taking notes. Multi-vendor compatibility also had to be addressed.
- The author says AI has resolved these challenges and made collaboration easy to use.

**What AI brings to meetings**
- Audio and video enhancements: echo cancelling and active speaker tracking and framing make meetings feel more natural.
- Transcription, translation and summaries: participants can listen, read or watch and rely on post-meeting transcription and summaries for the rest.
- Post-meeting analysis: AI can do the analysis or give a head start, for example showing who engages and typical meeting durations.

**HP|Poly capabilities named**
- Polycom, now HP|Poly, is described as a pioneer in this area.
- HP|Poly NoiseBlockAI and NoiseBlockAI v2 suppress background and distracting noise during meetings.
- HP|Poly DirectorAI provides presenter tracking and group framing.
- With compatibility for applications such as Microsoft Teams, post-meeting aids can be accessed immediately.

**The Symphony and HP|Poly integration**
The integration pairs these AI-driven capabilities with administration, monitoring, control and analysis of multi-vendor AV, UC and meeting environments, plus proactive alerts when there are trouble spots.

**How Symphony uses AI today**
- Headset battery life: before AI, Symphony could auto-create tickets from a battery value picked by a person, for example after 90 hours of headset use. HP|Poly has enabled some of its headsets with AI for battery life, so HP|Poly can send Symphony a low battery status and Symphony auto-creates the ticket for help desk personnel.
- AI-generated Tier 1 troubleshooting: the Symphony platform has this capability itself. If, for example, a link is down on a new HP|Poly device, it can reduce time to resolution by giving support resources the common steps to take or verify.

**When to use this**
Use when a customer asks how Symphony works with HP|Poly devices, whether Symphony uses AI, or how ticket creation and Tier 1 troubleshooting use AI.

**Not stated in this source**
No resolution-time figures, service levels or list of supported HP|Poly models are given.
